fields.statement: At HEAD, after b8bdc34 moved the arbiter to answer a question where it lives: testscript run-arbitrate-asked runs an autonomous workflow whose review command step makes review-check add a round-3 question with a session-less asked entry; the fake arbiter answers it, the journal has asked, arbiter and arbitrated (outcome pass) entries for it, and the run goes on to its next step; with an arbiter that writes nothing the run fails naming the question; a normal run runs no arbiter and leaves the question open. Testscript plan-workflow-autonomous-left runs an autonomous milestone plan whose review leaves two round-3 questions: one in the plan's open draft, one in a landed record write. Two arbiters run, both pass; the first writes into the draft (RHIZA_CHANGE set to the question's home change set), the second into a record change set of its own that lands once its answer passes; the run's check step ends pass and the gate accepts the draft with rule autonomous. arbiter-step, arbiter-question, arbiter-answer and plan-workflow-autonomous pass, and internal/run (TestCommandAsked*, Answer(question, session)) and internal/api (arbiterWrites, settleArbiterRecord, Answer by the session's Writes/WritesRecord, launchEnv) unit tests pass.

fields.statement: At HEAD, after b8bdc34: testscript run-gate passes: a normal run whose landed record adds an intent served by two drafts proposes both, accepts none, leaves the record landed, and run status --json names rhiza accept --rule owner for each; autonomous with a clean review both are accepted with rule autonomous and a reason naming the run; autonomous with a round-3 question both stay proposed and the gate exits 1 naming the question, then after a Decision answers it both are accepted; a run on an intention change set serving an existing intent proposes that change set; no RHIZA_RUN is usage. plan-workflow-autonomous-left: with review questions left in the draft and in a landed record write, each arbiter answers in the question's home change set (the draft) or its own landed record change set, and the gate then accepts the draft with rule autonomous. autonomous-gate-rule and plan-workflow-autonomous pass. Hands-on: a scratch build of HEAD, all RHIZA_* unset, in a scratch repo: rhiza run gate exited 2 saying RHIZA_RUN is not set.
